snippet.title: SantaCorps: Snow Patrol [Free Christmas Jam Game Release Trailer]
snippet.description:
A little present from Team V, made in one week for our holiday jam.
Play for free at http://virtuosoofficial.itch.io. 
Enjoy.

Design/Code/3D: Ethan Redd
2D Art and Addt. 3D: Seth Redd
OST: Still Crisp
SFX: 2 Mello
VOX: Lu Patterson
